title: Record signature verification via ssh-keygen -Y
description: Verify each record's .sig over exact file bytes with ssh-keygen -Y verify under its kind's namespace (git-vouch-register/-tier/-endorse/-revoke). Person .sig must hold one valid signature per current key. Signing key must match the did:key named in the record.
acceptance_criteria: Tests sign with real ssh-keygen; cross-namespace signature rejected; one-byte edit rejected; person file missing a current key's signature rejected; key/did mismatch rejected.
